The `package()` function does the usual `ar vx` + `tar -xzf` extraction of the Debian payload and `install`/`cp`/`ln -s` into `$pkgdir`; none of that runs during `--printsrcinfo`, so it is out of scope for this gate regardless.

No evidence of injected malicious behavior in the code that actually executes during metadata printing.
</details>
